Name: Emptor
Author: Evernow
Punchline: Buys a shopping list off the market board.
Description: Works a list of items, quantities and per-item price ceilings against the market board, buying the cheapest acceptable listings for you. Walks to a board, searches, and buys with human-variable timing. Exposes a Dalamud IPC API so other plugins can submit buy orders and read back what was purchased and at what price.

Name: AnoMech Testing
Author: Anomek
Punchline: Testing build of the AnoMech multiplayer branch.
Description: Unstable build of the multiplayer work in progress on Evernow/AnoMech's multiplayer-support branch. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics, with several people sharing one simulation. Installs alongside the normal AnoMech and keeps its own settings.
